tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i klu dbang rgyal po'i bum gter sgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru be/ rgyal ba'i ye shes thugs rje'i sprin phung las// 'gro la brtse ba'i phrin las char rgyun gyis// dge legs phan bde'i lo thog rgyas mdzad pa'i// bla ma klu dbang rgyal pos bdag la skyongs// 'gro kun las nyon nad dang dbul phongs sdug /sad ser lce 'bab 'jigs dang klu gdon sogs// nyes kun zhi nas mthun rkyen longs spyod dang*// khyim gnas pho mo bde zhing rigs brgyud 'phel// de sogs yon tan ma lus skyed pa'i phyir// rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub gsung bzhin du// yo byad ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i byin rlabs kyis// lha klu bum gter gzung 'brel bsgrub tshul spro// de la 'dir mchod rten nam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ khang bzangs la sogs pa bzhengs pa'i gzhir gzhug rgyu gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dod don gang yin gyi ched du sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i sgo nas klu'i gter bum bsgrub pa la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po ni/ nyi ma byang bgrod kyi yar tshes klu thebs shing 'di nyid kyi las la bsngags pa'i gza' skar sbyor byed phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ gnas khang gtsang mar bum pa yul gyi bre tshad pas mi chung ba'i bcud shong ba zangs sam/ rdza'i bum pa gang rung gtsang ma gas chag med pa'i lha bum gcig dang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar klu bum la'ang gcig 'byor pas mi lcogs pa dang mang po bsgrub dgos na lha klu gnyis ka bum pa gcig tu bsdus te bya ba stabs bde zhing 'gal ba med pas deng sang phyag len gnang ba bcas du yod bag phye 'o ma sogs kyis dam rtsi byas pa'i dkar zhal gyis byug spro na bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs dang*/ mdun rtags su lañja lta bus nām̐ yig bri/ gzhung nas bum pa'i nang sku gzugs 'dug par gsungs pas/

de'ang shug pa'i shing leb sgor mo rtsa rtse ma nor ba yu ba cung zad re yod pa la dri bzang dang mtshal bskus par gser dngul btul mas bri ba'am/ ma 'byor na dri bzang steng mtshal gyis lha lnga dang*/ klu dgu rnams so sor bris pa dang*/ klu sman bsre ba'i 'jim pa gtsang mar klu dbang rgyal po'i sku spar btab cing dngul 'dur ram dkar gsol ba/ gzhung du ma gsungs kyang spro na/ lha klu'i sngags rnams kyang 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'dod gsol dang bcas pa bris la dri bzang klu sman byugs nas dril te ras skud dkar pos dkris pa/ bya rgyud bum rdzas nyer lnga/ gzhung mthun gyi klu sman tshad ldan spang spos kyi phye ma dang bcas ras dkar du thum byas pa rnams bum pa'i grangs mnyam zangs gzhong lta bur bzhag gzhan yang lcags ra gan zha nye gsum ma gtogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs/ ske tshe shang tshe bra sran yungs kar ma gtogs pa'i 'bru shing tog khyung sder tsha ba gsum dug rigs klu bdud gla rtsi rnams ma gtogs pa'i sman me tog dri bzang*/ lpags rigs min pa'i nor sna/ sha chang sgog btsong la phug ma 'dres pa'i zas sna/ kha dog nag po min pa'i gos dar/ dur khrod kyi ma gtogs pa'i sa chu rdo shing dpal byin can/ bum pa mang na bungs skyed spang spos bal bu shug pa sogs bzang shing gi phye ma/ ba dmar mo dang ra dkar mo'i 'o ma bcas 'du bya/ rten gyi mdun du mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ nye logs su stegs gtsang mar rin po che'i snod du 'bru dkar gyi phung po spungs pa'i steng mañji'i khar bum pa bcud ldan ku shas kha brgyan pa dang*/ de'i steng du me long la gur gum gyis ye dharmā bris pa kha rgyan la brten te bsham/ gzhan yang sbyong chas sogs 'du bya/ bdag gi rnal 'byor 'og nas 'byung ba'i klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa'i mthar dbyung*/

de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyi yongs su gang ba'i steng du me long la bris pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs sngags gser btso ma ltar 'od zer 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rten rnams byin gyis rlob nus pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yig 'bru rnams la thim pas yig 'bru rnams las kyang de 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la ye dharmā gsung mi chag par thun du byas nas bzla/ thun bsdu ba ni/ slar yang 'od zer spro bsdu sngar bzhin mthar/ yig 'bru rnams kyang rten byin rlabs can byed pa'i nus pa can du gyur nas bum nang gi bdud rtsi la thim par bsams la sngags bzla bzhin du bzang po'i chus me long gi sngags rnams bkrus pa'i chu bum par blug de yang me tog gi phung po la thim pas nas 'bru re re bzhin ye dharmā'i yig 'bru re rer gyur par bsam mo// de nas rten gyi mdun du sbyong khrus kyi chas/ 'thor nas bshams par chab kyis bran te/ dpon slob rnams lha'i nga rgyal gyis bzhengs la/ mchod g.yog pas mtheb kyu rten la bskor ba dang bstun/ mchog sbyin gyi rgya bcas/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te nas/ khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes gsum/ ting lo changs bu bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs lan gsum byas nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la sogs pa rnams rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan ting lo lam sgron changs bu lam rgyags kyi tshul khyer la/

sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs kyis bstod/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis deng 'di dag rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs kyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nān u tsaṭ+ṭā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces btags pa yang yang brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ me long la shar ba'i rten gyi gzugs brnyan las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs phar phyin drug gi khrus dang*/ de dag sku la nas/ bi sho dha ne swā hās sku phyi/ rten bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du/ sku rten rnams oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ gzungs dril yod na gsung rten rnams āḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs kyis spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim pa de 'dra lan gsum bya/ de nas mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis rgyas gdab/ rang dang rten gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang skur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ ji ltar sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sku thams cad gang*/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du re re bzhin sbyar bas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rjes spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug mtha' yas sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan cing sems can gyi don la gzigs pa 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo// slar yang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs gong ltar mchod cing bstod/ bskyed pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/

slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs dang*/ ye dharmā mang du brjod pas rdzas yo byad dang bcas par brtan bzhugs nan tan bya/ slar yang mchod bstod dang bkra shis bya'o// de nas lha bum du klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga/ klu bum la rang rang gi las sgrub pa'i khyad par gyis gang la mos pas gtso bo bya bar kha cig tu bshad kyang*/ spyi khyab tu bskyed chog gi go rim ltar nor rgyas dbus dang*/ stobs rgyu shar du bya ba sogs sku dang gzungs yod na'ang de rnams ma nor bar gzhug lha klu gcig tu bsdu na'ang bkod lugs gong ltar la/ 'di'i tshe bum pa'i smad char klu dgu/ stong tshar lha lnga'am ma lcogs na klu dbang rgyal po'i sku rkyang pas 'thus shing na bza' dkar po gsol/ thams cad kyang gtso bo'i zhal mdun rtags la bstan cing*/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la lta bar bya/ de lta bu'i bum pa rnams su gong gi rdzas rnams dang khyad par lha bum du bum rdzas nyer lnga/ klu bum du klu sman thum snying por khel pas sku dang gzungs yo 'khrul ma song zhing slar kha dma' bar mi 'gyur ba'i tshags dam pos mgrin pa'i bar du bkang la chu gtsang dang gong gi 'o mas brdzis pa'i 'dam pas kha bcad cing ras dkar gyis gtum/ ras skud dkar dmar gang rung gis mgul pa bcings te rgyab tu rtags gdab/ de nas lha klu so so'i skabs stegs bu gtsang ma la rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris par klu bum/ de'i steng du mañjir bum gdan la lha bum/ lha klu gcig bsdus la thams cad kyi gdan du tshon nam 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu pad 'dab brgyad kyi tshul re bkram pa'i steng du bkod pa ste/ de ltar sgrub pa po du yod kyi grangs zhal rang la phyogs par bsham/ gang ltar yang de'i mdun du dkar mngar klu sman bsres pa'i lha klu'i gtor ma'i bar du phyogs skyong ste zlum gtor re/

mtha' skor du nyer spyod rnams 'byor na re re la tshar re/ ma 'byor na spyi khyab tu kha gsor rung bas gcig gtor ma rnams la khur ba sogs dang dkar gsum shing thog gang 'dzoms gtsang mas bskor zhing 'o mas bran/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du dar ras sam rgya shog dmar po'i 'phan gdugs 'dzugs/ gzhan yang gtor ril/ 'o chab/ a gar spos dkar spang spos rnams kyi bdug spos rnams kyang 'du bya/ 'di rnams la sha chang la sogs pa klu la gnod pa'i rigs cung zad tsam yang ma 'dres pa dang*/ khyad par rdzas dang yo byad thams cad gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon sogs sgrub pa po rnams khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas stan bde bar rten la kha phyogs pas 'khod de/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad kyi bgegs bsal/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da aḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod cing rol mo bcas byin gyis brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes skyabs sems ci nus byas la/ rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

na maḥta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par bya/ tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs nas tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug gi rgyal po sku mdog in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ mgrin pa yan chad dkar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyen la phyogs pa'i chun po'i rgyab yol mnga' zhing sbrul mjug rnams gdan du bting ba'o// de'i mdun du sgrib sel dkar po g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang*/ g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu ser po ut+pa la'i steng na gnas pa'i ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu lta zhing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de dag gi g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/

g.yon du dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// 'og tu klu'i tshogs thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs te gdong gyen du lta ba'o// spro na/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khod par bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros klus gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thug rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ zhes mi tshig gis bar ma chod par ji tsam nus pa bzla/ thun las ldang ba na 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ de nas bum pa rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las steng 'og bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam par pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du hūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams yangs shing rgya che ba/

nang bcud 'bru dang zas nor sman dang rin po che la sogs pa lha mi'i 'dod yon longs spyod sna tshogs pa zad pa med pa'i gter chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur par bsams te byin gyis brlab pa ni/ so so'i phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan pa'i mos pas bskor/ sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod/ ji skad bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bas thog mar chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā ba bi shud+dho3haṃ/ yo byad kyi ma dag pa thams cad stong par sbyangs par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong sbyar ba'i tshigs bar pa rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag ste/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shā mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ.ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa oṃ maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdzas rnams mgron so so'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas yo byad la dbang ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ yo byad rnams 'khor 'das kyi mgron so sos gang la gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'dzad med 'byung bar bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar bzhag g.yon mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ke te na maḥs man+ta swa ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dza la ni hūm̐/

yo byad la 'thab rtsod med par so so'i mos pa bzhin rang dbang du thob par bsam/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'am lha mgron spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ sor mo rnams nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ra pra bhañja te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron rnams dam tshig dbang gis bdag la srung skyob mdzad nas phan bde'i phrin las sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad par bsam/ spro na/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// zhes sogs bden stobs kyang brjod/ de lta bu'i stem̐ng gim̐ bumam̐ pam̐'i

char dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po sogs nas/ de nyid sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor rnams dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis sngar ltar bskyed/ 'og gi bum̐m char pam̐'i nam̐ng dum̐ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du nām̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su nor rgyas/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du wa ru ṇa/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bstod lha'i lus can/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang por sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan cing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa yid bzhin kyi nor bus gang ba thogs te gdong gyen du phyogs nas bcom ldan 'das la lta ba/ g.yon phyogs nas rang rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas bsten pa/ gzhan yang klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs dpag tu med pa rnams kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la gus pas lta ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spro na/ ma lus sems can sogs gdan 'bul ba'i bar tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/

me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gis lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ slar yang bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ lan gsum gyis spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes klu dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa sna tshogs pa spros nas lha rnams la mchod par bsams zhing thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog nas shab+da'i bar byas la/ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇis rol mo phul nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// gdugs mchog ji snyed yod pa dang*// sogs sngags kyi rjes su/

tsha traṃ ga pū dza te hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ba dan/ pa taṃ ka lda ldi/ pa ḍa da ma pū dzi te hūm̐/ yang rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra sogs dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// sogs nas sngags kyi rjes su/ tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐ zhes pa ltar rin chen bdun dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga rnams dbul bar bya'o// de nas bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ spros bral gnyis med ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar// dbang sngon sku la mtshan dpe'i rgyu skar bkra// ma rig dug 'joms ston zla nya ba'i zhal// thugs rje'i bsil zer ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsal// ngur smrig rnam gsum dug gsum tsha gdung skyob// chos kun mtha' bral ston pa'i phyag rgya can// pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil klung bzhugs// sna tshogs gdengs can sprul ba'i sku la bstod// ma lus 'gro ba'i sgrib sel gangs ri'i mdog /pad+ma'i mdangs ldan byams pa thugs rje'i gter// mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal gser bzang 'od// brtse ba'i bdag nyid pad dkar spyan ras gzigs// tshad med rang bzhin sems dpa' bzhi la bstod// gzhan yang byang sems dgra bcom grangs med dang*// chu gter dbus nas klu rgyal du mas 'dud// gtso 'khor rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas de'i rjes su/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// lan nyer gcig brjod/ slar yang mchod pa rnams kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams 'di'am dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'jig rten dge legs mdzod// oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du puṣ+pe nas lda ldi'i bar gong bzhin klu rnams la dbul lo// klu'i bstod pa ni/ mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams// chu gter rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' rab zab nas// rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras yid 'ong ba'i// pho brang 'byor pa che ldan gnas na bzhugs// dbu la sbrul mgo gdengs ka'i tshogs dbus na// yid bzhin nor bu bsam kun rdzogs byed cing*// bdag gzhan don 'byor phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas// 'od 'bar la sogs mun sel rnams kyis brgyan// tshe rabs du mar yon tan legs sbyangs mthus// klu dbang 'byor pa mtha' yas yang dag rdzogs// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab khyed la 'dud// ces dang*/ gdengs ka nor bu sogs nas/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ de nas gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis bran te/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das la/ oṃ ta thā ga to bhā ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pa ri wā re i daṃ pa liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa bsdu na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu gnyan sa bdag gi nad dang nyer 'tshe la sogs pa las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ lag pa g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas 'jig rten skyong ba rnams spyan drang*/ sngags de nyid la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las gzhol/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo zhes sogs lan dgu brjod pas klu rnams la dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ dad ldan rgyal ba'i zhal mthong bka' thos shing*// sgrub pa brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud// thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa// bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud// sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos ltar// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir// dam las ma 'da' dam tshig rjes dgongs la// gsol btab las mdzad bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod// klu yi rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas bstod pa dang phrin las gzhol lo// de nas bum pa sgrub pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gzhung las/ zhag bdun du snying po rgyun ma chad par bzlas na dbul ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// thun mong gi nor rdzas la longs spyod par 'gyur ro// sad dang ser ba dang*/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas gzungs thag gi rdo rje bum pa so so'i tshe steng ma'i khar bzhag nas sne mo rang gis bzung ste/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum la mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab/

mkha' khyab rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la snying rje drag po bsgom/ khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan yul lha gzhi bdag mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la byams pa dang snying rje drag po yang yang bskyed nas/ rang nyid klu dbang rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ yig sngon po gsal ba las 'od dkar po zla ba shar ba ltar 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'od zer phyir 'phros/ mdun gyi sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor rnams la phog thugs rgyud bskul te de dag las 'od dkar po'i phreng ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la phog de rnams kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par so so'i lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag stobs dang gzi brjid bkrag mdangs nyams pa dang*/ 'khor dang longs spyod nyams pa thams cad sos/ nad dang duḥkha zhi zhing bde ba dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros te rigs drug dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas steng gi bar snang du sprin gyi phung po chen por 'thibs pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te skom pa'i sdug bsngal bsal bar bsam/ yang sprin gyi gseb nas rin po che dang rgyan gos zas nor longs spyod ji ltar 'dod pa babs/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs zhi bar byas/ khyad par lha klu 'byung po rnams la rang rang gang 'dod pa'i zas gos rgyan dang longs spyod yongs su smin par byas te/ phan bde dpag tu med pa bsgrubs par bsams nas/ sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes stong phrag gcig bzla/ zhag bdun du mi chad par bzla na dge 'dun lnga sogs du yod kyis gzungs thag re mos su bzung nas sngags rgyun mi chad par bya'o// bzlas pa rdzogs nas gong ltar gsol ba btab la/

gzungs thag klu'i bum khar spos la bzung*/ rang klu dbang rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer snga ma ltar 'phros/ klu rnams kyi snying gar phog pas shin tu mnyes shing phrin las bskul nas spyi bo'i yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ phyag gi bum pa nas 'dod rgu sna tshogs byung ste bum pa khengs nas lud pas gnas khang dang nye 'khor thams cad longs spyod kyis phyur bur khyab par bsams la/ klu rnams kyi sngags ni/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ba su kā ya phuḥswā hā/ nor rgyas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza karko ṭā ya phuḥswā hā/ stobs rgyu'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza shaṅkha pā lā ya phuḥswā hā/ dung skyong gi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza a nan+ta ya phuḥswā hā/ mtha' yas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza wa ru ṇā ya phuḥswā hā/ chu bdag gi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza tak+ṣa kā ya phuḥswā hā/ 'jog po'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ku li kā ya phuḥswā hā/ rigs ldan gyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza pad+ma ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ma hā pad+ma ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma chen po'i 'o// zhes pa rnams brgya rtsa re bzlas nas/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sbyin bdag la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa stsal zhing*/ gnas 'dir bkra shis dang dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i 'dod don gsol/ de nas thams cad la thun mong du gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par spro na klu gtor gzhan du gsal ba ltar dang*/ dkyus tsam du/ zangs sogs rin po che'i gzhong par ril bu ci mang dang klu sman mngar gsum 'o ma me tog la sogs blugs la chus bkang nas/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya g.yon khu tshur mthe bong bsgreng pa'i steng g.yas pa'i thal mos gdugs ltar bkab/ mchan/ byas la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ oṃbhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dz+ruṃ phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa gcig gis gtor ma phul ba'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag dang sbyin bdag la klu'i gnod pa mi 'byung zhing*/ yul phyogs 'dir dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos bsang sbyang byas la byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ slar yang klu rnams la/ oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gong bzhin rjes su rol mo 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs dang*/ gdengs ka nor bu sogs kyis bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor klu rgyal chen po rnams dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi nad dang nyer 'tshe la sogs pa las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa stsal zhing gnas 'dir bkra shis dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes thun mong du 'dod don gsol la yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ bum pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs nas/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs sogs/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang thams cad stsal zhing*/

yul phyogs 'dir bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sam/ bsdu na/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyi mthar su pra tiṣ+ṭha ci mang brjod pas brtan bzhugs dang*/ rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas la me tog gtor ro// yang sgrub pa po gcig gis bum pa cha mang po sgrub dgos na/ bum pa cha re la snga ma bzhin mchod gtor nas rab gnas bar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba tshar re bya'o// de ltar byas pa'i mthar rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /klu dbang rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo ba dang*/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ sogs/ lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// sogs/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// sogs smon lam dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ de yang gzhung las/ bum pa gnyis kyang 'og tu klu'i bum pa dang*/ steng du bcom ldan 'das kyi bum pa bzhag nas gnas khang gi shar phyogs su gter du sbas na phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'gyur ro// klu'i gnod pa thams cad bral bar 'gyur ro// khyim de'i skyes pa dang bud med thams cad dar bar 'gyur ro// zhes byin rlabs dang phan yon ches che bar gsungs pa'i gter bum de nyid gang du sba ba'i sa gtsang mar mchod gtor dang bcas grub na cho ga tshar gcig btang*/ ma grub kyang brtan bzhugs dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par brjod de/ char chu byi ba sogs kyi skyon mi 'byung ba'i rdo sgrom gyi nang du tshags legs par byas la bzhugs/ dus dang rgyun du mchod pa dang klu gtor 'bul ba sogs byung na shin tu legs pa yin no// 'di ni gtso cher khang par bsngags shing*/ yul lha'i lto ba dang*/ chu mig gi mgo sogs la sbas na'ang phan yon de ltar 'byung ngo*// rgyal bas lung bstan rab dga'i sar bzhugs pa'i// rgyal sras 'phags mchog klu sgrub gsung bzhin du// rgyal ba klu dbang lha klu'i bum pa'i gter// rgyal bstan yun ring gnas phyir tshul 'di spel// rnam dag mkhas pa'i gzhung bzang la brten nas// rnam mang 'khrul zad gong ma'i phyag len bzhin// rnam dbye'i blo yis brtags nas gsal bar byas// rnam dkar dge ba ma gyur 'gro la bsngo// de mthus snod kyi dpal 'byor phyogs mthar rgyas// bcud kyi skye 'gro las nyon rgyu 'bras zhi// bcom ldan klu dbang go 'phang myur thob ste// nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba'i don sgrub shog
